issues.detail: The Hebrew has two distinct terms: אֹתֹתַי ('my signs') and מוֹפְתַי ('my wonders/portents'). The Chinese renders both as '神蹟' (signs/miracles), collapsing the distinction. While this is a lexical choice, it loses the second distinct concept 'wonders' and could mislead a reader into thinking only one category is mentioned twice.
